changes.evidence: Season 3, episodes 3x16-3x20: Daisy is infected by Hive and serves him (kills Malick, frames Lincoln, steals the Kree beacon and Terrigen crystals and runs off to Hive), until Lash frees her in 3x20 and she rejoins S.H.I.E.L.D. against Hive before going rogue at the end of 3x22. Possessed service counts. The dataset files Hive's organization as HYDRA (T:st-hive, Giyera), so that name is used here.

Season 2: Bobbi is revealed (2x05) as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who went undercover as HYDRA's head of security, and the show tells her earlier S.H.I.E.L.D. service (the Iliad and Gonzales). S.H.I.E.L.D. is her past group and goes first; the record makes it look as if she started in HYDRA and later joined S.H.I.E.L.D.

Season 3, episode 3x01 'Laws of Nature': after Afterlife ends, Lincoln works as a doctor at Cincinnati Memorial Hospital. Lash's attack and the ATCU drive him out (3x01-3x03), and he joins S.H.I.E.L.D. in 3x07. A news report on screen calls it the 'Cincinnati Hospital'. The full name comes from the wiki, so check it if the exact name matters.

Season 7, episode 7x07 'The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D': stranded in 1982-83, Deke forms a band that doubles as an unofficial S.H.I.E.L.D. unit ('I wanna introduce you to the Deke Squad'). In 7x13 he stays in that timeline as Director of its S.H.I.E.L.D. A band counts as a group.

Season 3, episode 3x01 'Laws of Nature': her file, shown on screen, lists earlier service under aliases: the CIA (2008-09), NASA's Project Valhalla (2010-12), and a joint MI5/MI6 taskforce in London. In 3x06 she says 'I was the spy taking risks.' These are past groups told on screen, so they are stages keyed to her first title, ahead of the ATCU.

Season 3: Andrew Garner is a Culver University professor. In 3x02 'Purpose in the Machine' he teaches Psychology 101 there and returns there after assessing Joey, and in 3x07 'Chaos Theory' he holds May at Culver. The Lash file leaves out this workplace, which his A twin records.

owner_calls.question: Should Daisy's stay at Afterlife in season 2 (2x16-2x22) be a stage?
options: Add ['Afterlife','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2'] then ['S.H.I.E.L.D.','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2']
owner_calls.evidence: Gordon takes Skye to Afterlife (2x16), where she lives under Jiaying's rules and trains with her. She goes back to S.H.I.E.L.D., returns to Afterlife as Coulson's go-between (2x20), and turns on Jiaying (2x22). She lives there as a member of the community, but she stays loyal to Coulson throughout.

owner_calls.question: Does Garner's consulting for S.H.I.E.L.D. make him a member, and should his returns to Culver be moves?
options: Culver University only (consulting is a hire, not membership)
[Culver S2, S.H.I.E.L.D. S2, Culver S2, S.H.I.E.L.D. S3] (he goes back to Culver at the end of 2x13 and consults again in season 3)
owner_calls.evidence: In 2x13 'One of Us' he refuses May's offer to stay with S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes back to Culver. In season 3 he assesses Inhumans for S.H.I.E.L.D. while still teaching at Culver. Only a guidebook, not the screen, calls him a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

owner_calls.question: Should Deke's season 5 and 6 groups be recorded: the True Believers (2091, season 5) and his own tech company (season 6, before Mack makes him an agent)?
options: Add his company before S.H.I.E.L.D. S6 (the screen never names it: 'This is my company'; the wiki calls it 'Deke Shaw's Company')
owner_calls.evidence: Season 5: his mother was a True Believer, and he sides with the True Believers and S.H.I.E.L.D. against Kasius (5x07-5x09). The wiki lists him as a former True Believer. Season 6 (6x04 onward): he founds and runs a Silicon Valley tech company. Mack officially makes him a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent in 6x12.

owner_calls.question: Should Mace's pre-S.H.I.E.L.D. groups be recorded: journalist at International Affairs, and Talbot's Project Patriot?
options: Add ['International Affairs','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4'] first
Also add Project Patriot (a government program he is the subject of, like Mike's Project Centipede)
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU wiki (citing 4x05 'Lockup') says he was a journalist at International Affairs before Vienna. Talbot picks him for Project Patriot, which gives him his powers; this is revealed in 4x10-4x12. I could not confirm the exact on-screen line for the journal.

owner_calls.question: Is the University of Seville still his group after season 1?
options: Keep University of Seville as the last stage
Add a departure at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1 (he leaves to start over; by season 3 he is in a Norwegian jail, not teaching)
owner_calls.evidence: At the end of 1x08 'The Well' he says it may be 'time to start over somewhere else', and Coulson suggests Portland. In 3x02 he is found in a prison cell in Norway, lying low. The screen never says outright that he quit the university.
